reports.title: The operations of the Company are seasonal, and the results of operations for any interim period are not necessarily indicative of operations for the full fiscal year or any future period.

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: A discussion of management's expectations as to the Company's outlook for the three months ending December 31, 2026 and fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 is contained in the Company's press release dated November 5, 2026 under the heading "Financial Outlook". The press release is available on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.com and on EDGAR at www.sec.gov. Information contained in, or otherwise accessed through, such press release is not deemed part of this MD&A and such press release and information is not incorporated by reference herein.
